title: Optimized HT gDNA extraction from Dried Blood Spot using QIAcube HT
author: Abebe A. Fola
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bh69j9h6
materials: Open the QIAcube control software (version 1.6.61) and select the Buccals_350ul_QCHT_withALEtOHmix_min_V5_dk protocol. Follow instructions provided by the software and manual. Change the final elution volume to 120 µL , but otherwise use default parameters. In addition, consider the following notes as needed: Fill the water bath with deionized water. Turn on to preheat at 56 °C . Start with a clean QIAcube HT. If left idle for longer than 1 week, run the UV light for 00:30:00 . Check Buffer AL for precipitates. If present, incubate in the water bath at 56 °C for at least 00:05:00 . Remember to import sample IDs using pre-prepared .csv file. See the HT manual on how to prepare and import a .csv file. Reagents volumes are provided by the QIAcube software based on the number of samples to be included in the run, but it is important to add an extra 10% volume for the AL/Ethanol mix. Fill the reservoir reagents with the appropriate volumes under a clean and UVed biological safety cabinet (BSC) using sterile serological pipettes. Thoroughly mix AL/Ethanol solution in a 50 mL Falcon tube by vortexing at least 1 minute (or until the solution is homogeneous). If running less than 96 samples, make sure to hermetically seal unused columns/wells with a Tape Pad to avoid vacuum errors. Make sure all components (Elution plate, QIAamp plate, and when ready - the S-Bock) are pushed firmly to the upper left portion of their carriages within QIAcube HT robot.

steps.title: Prepare S-Block and Sample Mapping
steps.instruction: Label a new S-Block with date, project name, and sample type. Generate a .csv file containing sample ID and well position for import into the QIAcube HT robot.

steps.title: Punch DBS Samples
steps.instruction: Extract blood sections from DBS samples and place them into the S-block.

substeps.instruction: Remove DBS sample from storage bag using clean tweezers and place face-up on a cutting mat.
Use a clean 6mm Uni-Core punch to remove a circular section and eject it directly into the respective S-block well.
Repeat to ensure each well contains two 6mm punched circles per sample.

steps.title: Clean Punching Equipment
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the Uni-Core punch and cutting mat between samples.

substeps.instruction: Immerse Uni-Core punch in 10% bleach for 10 seconds.
Immerse Uni-Core punch in 70% ethanol for 10 seconds.
Allow punch to air dry (use a rotation of at least 4 Uni-Cores to maintain workflow).
Spray the cutting mat with 70% ethanol and wipe dry after each DBS sample.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lysis Buffer mix in a 50 mL Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Check Buffer ATL for precipitates; if visible, incubate in a water bath at 56 °C for 5 minutes or until dissolved.
Combine 360 µL Buffer ATL and 20 µL Proteinase K per sample, including an extra 10% volume to account for transfer loss.
Vortex at 2,000 rpm for at least 10 seconds.
Transfer the solution to a 50 mL reservoir using a serological pipette.

steps.title: Dispense Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add Lysis Buffer to the S-Block and seal immediately.

substeps.instruction: Use a multichannel pipette to dispense 380 µL Lysis Buffer into each well containing blood punches.
Seal the S-Block with a Tape Pad.
Note: Use the Lysis Buffer immediately after preparation to avoid precipitation.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the S-Block in a Thermomixer.

substeps.instruction: Set Thermomixer to 56 °C at 900 rpm.
Load S-Block, cover with lid, and incubate overnight (16 hours).

steps.title: Centrifuge S-Block
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the S-Block using a plate centrifuge, ensuring it is properly balanced, at 2,400 RCF for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a new, labeled S-Block.

substeps.instruction: Gently remove the Tape Pad seal.
Use a 200 µL multichannel pipette to transfer a total of 350 µL of lysate (175 µL x 2) to a new S-Block, avoiding the filter paper debris.
Seal the original S-block containing filter paper and store at -20 °C for potential future re-extraction.

steps.title: Run QIAcube HT
steps.instruction: Process the lysate using the QIAcube HT robot.

substeps.instruction: Place the new S-Block containing lysate into the QIAcube carriage.
Follow software instructions to start the run.
Save the Pre-Run Report for troubleshooting purposes.

steps.title: Post-Run Processing and Storage
steps.instruction: Finalize the run and store the extracted gDNA.

substeps.instruction: Save the Post-Run Report.
Apply Elution Cap Strips to the Elution Plate.
Transfer to storage: -20 °C for short-term or -80 °C for long-term storage.

steps.title: Clean Instrument
steps.instruction: Clean the QIAcube instrument following the software and manual instructions after each run.
